episodes.title: The Call Is Coming From Inside
episodes.hook: This phone calls itself until your app dies
episodes.logline: The Caller keeps answering his own call, stacking phones into a tower until Junior gives him a reason to hang up.

beats.text: The Call Is Coming From Inside
beats.sub: This phone calls itself until your app dies

say.text: Hold on, I'll just call myself!

beats.narration: Every call makes another call. Nobody ever hangs up.

beats.note: A base case gives the recursion a floor to stop at.
beats.narration: Junior added a base case. At zero, the phone finally hangs up.

beats.lesson: Every recursive function needs a base case it can actually reach.

episodes.caption:
He just wanted to talk. Forever.

Recursion without a base case never stops calling. Add a case that returns without calling again.

What's the deepest stack trace you've ever scrolled?

episodes.title: Room Zero
episodes.hook: Your loop just knocked on a door that doesn't exist
episodes.logline: Ollie visits one room too many and finds undefined behind the door.

beats.sub: Your loop just knocked on a door that doesn't exist

say.text: Good evening! Room four, I presume?

beats.narration: Three rooms. Indexes zero, one, two. Ollie knocked on four.

beats.note: Indexes stop at length - 1, so use <.

beats.lesson: Arrays start at 0. The last index is length - 1.

episodes.caption:
He's not creepy. He's just one off.

Arrays start at 0, so a loop with <= length runs one time too many.

Be honest: how many times this week?

episodes.title: Just One More Listener
episodes.hook: Your app slows down because you keep feeding this thing
episodes.logline: Every re-render feeds The Leak another listener until the manor slows to a crawl.

beats.sub: Your app slows down because you keep feeding this thing

beats.error: Every render adds another listener. None are removed.
beats.narration: Each time this runs, it feeds the Leak another listener.

beats.note: Return a cleanup that removes the listener.

beats.lesson: Whatever you add in an effect, remove in its cleanup.

episodes.caption:
It was so small once.

Listeners added in useEffect stay forever unless your cleanup removes them.

What's the biggest memory leak you've hunted?
